resources.string: Read-only report snapshots, not live prices. Holdings exclude cash and are not added to home net worth, avoiding duplicate brokerage balances.
Reading the brokerage report. This may take a minute…
Connect your own IBKR account. View reports only; no orders or transfers.
No open positions in this report
Remove the credentials and holdings cached on this phone. Brokerage and bookkeeping accounts are unchanged. To revoke the token, generate a new one in IBKR.

In IBKR Client Portal, open Reports → Flex Queries and create an Activity Flex Query:

• Format: XML; date format: yyyyMMdd; period: Last Business Day
• Add Open Positions, choose Summary and all fields, not Lots
• Save the Query ID; enable Flex Web Service and generate a token

Keep the empty Open Positions section when there are no holdings.

The token grants access to reports. Keep it private. Credentials and holdings are encrypted on this device, excluded from backups, and sent directly to IBKR, not a Cashiro server. Reconnect after reinstalling.
Check the Flex Token and Query ID, and enable Flex Web Service.
The token expired. Generate a new token in IBKR, disconnect this connection and add it again.
IBKR restricted this IP. Check the token IP restrictions.
Use an XML Activity Flex Query with Open Positions (Summary) and all fields.
The report is not ready. Refresh later. Existing holdings are retained.
Too many requests. Wait at least a minute before refreshing.
Connection failed. Check your network and retry. Existing holdings are retained.
Unexpected report format or fields. Check XML, date format and summary position fields. Existing holdings are retained.
This app version does not support that provider yet.
Encrypted storage failed. This operation was not saved. Retry; existing bookkeeping data is unchanged.
This connection or brokerage account was already added. Refresh the existing connection.
